blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Benchmarks of class-imbalance strategies for multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) prediction are often evaluated on record-level splits of cohorts in which one patient contributes several radiographs. We audit such a benchmark on 29,083 MIMIC-CXR radiographs of 10,479 patients with eight diagnosis targets. First, the record-split benchmark was misleading: a lookup table that copies the label of a development-set radiograph with the same EHR vector nearly matched the best model, and on unseen patients every model fell to the level of predicting every case positive. Second, tracing the labels back to MIMIC-IV explained why: each patient's labels are keyword matches on the diagnosis codes of a single admission, copied, with one EHR vector per patient, to all of the patient's radiographs, so about a third of the radiographs carry labels that differ from the codes of their own admission. Third, under patient-separated evaluation with admission-aligned and rule-refined labels, the initial conclusions do not hold: in the evaluated configurations no imbalance strategy raised the observed mean macro F2 over no augmentation by more than 0.01, tuned tree ensembles showed no consistent advantage over tuned logistic regression, and the released EHR variables stayed at the level of the all-positive baseline, whereas the diagnostic history available at imaging time and image embeddings exceeded it, including, with rule-refined labels, a CheXpert-trained encoder that never saw these radiographs; RAD-DINO had seen 96.6% of them during self-supervised pretraining. Adding either encoder to the diagnostic history gave no statistically significant F2 gain; exploratory AUROC gains were significant with RAD-DINO but not with DenseNet. We provide reusable diagnostics, a leakage-aware protocol and a checklist.
blocks.zh: 对多式胸X射线(CXR)和电子健康记录预测的班级平衡战略基准,往往在记录级别分组中加以评价,其中一名病人提供几幅放射图。 我们对有8个诊断目标的10 479名病人的29 083幅MIMIC-CXR放射图进行了这一基准审计。 首先,分录基准有误导性:一个检索表复制了同一种EHR矢量的开发套射线图的标签,几乎与最佳模型相符,在看不见的病人身上,每个模型都降到了预测每个病例阳性的水平。 第二,将标签追溯回MIMIC-IV,解释了为什么:每个病人的标签是单次录入的诊断代码上的关键词匹配,复制,每个病人有一个EHR矢量,到所有病人的放射图上,因此大约三分之一的放射图上带有与自己录入的代码不同的标签. 第三,在患者与患者分开的评估中,加上符合录取要求和完善规则的标签,初步结论并不认为:在评估的配置中,没有不平衡战略将观察到的平均值F2提高到不超过0.01, 调制的树木组合与调制的物流回归相比没有一致的优势,所释放的EHR变量停留在全阳性基线的水平上,而成像时间和图像嵌入的诊断历史超过了这一水平,包括使用改进规则的标签,一个从未见过这些无线电图的CheXpert训练编码器;RAD-DINO在自我监督的预先训练中曾见过96.6%。 在诊断史上添加编码器或编码器,在统计学上没有带来显著的F2收益;探索性的AUROC收益在RAD-DINO方面是显著的,但在DenseNet方面则不是显著的。 我们提供可重复使用的诊断、渗漏意识协议和核对表。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Chest radiographs and structured EHR variables are routinely combined in clinical prediction research, and public resources such as MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV make this easy to do at scale [ 1 , 2 ] . Many of the diagnostic targets in such cohorts are rare, so studies often add a class-imbalance step: random or synthetic oversampling, class weighting or balanced ensembles [ 3 , 4 ] . Benchmarks that cross these strategies with feature representations and classifiers are attractive because they promise practical guidance: which sampler to use, which modality carries the signal, and whether fusion helps.
blocks.zh: 胸射线图和结构化的EHR变量在临床预测研究中例行结合,而MIMIC-CXR和MIMIC-IV等公共资源使得这在规模[1,2]上容易完成. 这类组群中的许多诊断指标是罕见的,因此研究往往会添加一个类-不平衡步骤:随机或合成的过标,类加权或均衡的综艺[3,4]. 将这些战略与特征表述和分类方法相交叉的基准具有吸引力,因为它们保证提供实际指导:使用哪种取样器,采用哪种方式传递信号,以及核聚变是否有帮助。

blocks.en: Such guidance is only as good as the evaluation protocol. In MIMIC-derived cohorts one patient usually contributes several radiographs. When labels and EHR variables are attached at the patient level, a record-level split places copies of the same patient, with the same label and the same EHR vector, on both sides of the train–test boundary. Record-wise versus subject-wise evaluation is a known pitfall in clinical machine learning [ 5 ] , and leakage of this kind is among the most common causes of irreproducible results in machine-learning-based science [ 6 , 7 ] . Its consequences for imbalance benchmarks, however, are rarely quantified.
blocks.zh: 这种指导与评价协议一样好。 在MIMIC衍生的组群中,一名患者通常会提供多幅放射图. 当标签和EHR变量在患者层面被附加时,一个记录层面的分出会将同一患者的复制品放入列车-测试边界两侧,标签和EHR矢量相同. 记录式和主题式评价是临床机器学习中已知的陷阱[5],而这种泄漏是机器学习科学中无法产生结果的最常见原因之一[6,7]. 然而,它对不平衡基准的影响很少量化。

blocks.en: We study this problem in a case study. We first benchmarked class-imbalance strategies on a published MIMIC CXR–EHR cohort with eight binary targets [ 8 , 9 ] , whose labels come from keyword-matched ICD codes and whose EHR variables were merged per patient, using a random split over radiographs. This initial run gave clear answers: EHR-only models won every target (macro F2 0.737 vs. 0.457 for early fusion and 0.283 for image-only), Random Forest and Extra Trees won every target, and different oversamplers “won” different targets. Auditing the run against the MIMIC source tables showed that all three conclusions follow from patient leakage and from the way the labels were built. Our aim is therefore not to recommend an augmentation strategy for each disease, but to test whether such recommendations survive leakage- and label-aware evaluation, and to identify what improves performance once they do not. Such benchmarks combine three kinds of prior knowledge with different roles: domain rules that map codes to targets, prior diagnoses known at imaging time that can serve as inputs, and representations learned by image pretraining, whose data may include the evaluation images. We ask whether the apparent contributions of clinical history and visual representations survive patient-separated, provenance-aware evaluation, and whether image information adds value beyond the diagnostic knowledge available at prediction time.
blocks.zh: 我们在案例研究中研究这个问题。 我们首先在公布的MIMIC CXR-EHR组上制定班级平衡战略,该组有8个二进制目标[8,9],其标签取自关键词相匹配的ICD代码,其EHR变量被每个患者合并,使用随机分取的射电图. 最初的运行给出了明确的答案: EHR型只获得每个目标(早期聚变的宏F2 0.737对0.457,只获得图像的0.283),随机森林和外加 树木赢得了每一个目标,不同的超标者“完”了不同的目标。 根据MIMIC源表对运行情况进行的审计表明,这三项结论都来自病人的渗漏和标签的制作方式。 因此,我们的目的不是为每种疾病建议一项增强战略,而是检验这些建议是否在渗漏和标注评估之后幸存下来,并查明哪些建议一旦没有改进业绩。 这种基准将三种先前的知识与不同的作用结合在一起:将代码映射到目标上的域规则,在成像时已知的可作为输入的先行诊断,和通过图像预训学到的表示,其数据可能包括评价图像. 我们问,临床史和视觉表现的明显贡献是否在病人分开的、了解出处的评价中存在,图像信息是否在预测时的诊断知识之外增加价值。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Reusable diagnostics for benchmarks on multi-record clinical cohorts, which need no retraining or only trivial baselines: a no-learning EHR lookup table, a seen/unseen-patient split of the test set, an identifier test for tabular features, a reconstruction of the labels from source codes, and a prior-diagnosis baseline. • A leakage and label audit of the case study: three leakage channels and an exact reconstruction of the released labels from MIMIC-IV codes showing that several target names do not match the codes behind them (Section III ). • A leakage-aware re-benchmark with record, patient-grouped, patient-level and calendar-time splits; released, admission-aligned, rule-refined and report-derived (CheXpert) labels; type-aware oversampling; tuned classifiers; and richer image representations (Sections IV – V ). • A checklist for multimodal imbalance benchmarks (Section VI ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:对多记录临床组别的基准进行可重复使用的诊断,这些基准不需要再培训,或仅是微不足道的基线:一个不学习的EHR检索表,一个看/不看病人的分机,一个表格特征的标识测试,从源代码中重建标签,以及一个前诊断基线。 对案例研究进行渗漏和标签审计:三个渗漏通道和MIMIC-IV编码中释放出标签的确切重建,表明若干目标名称与后面的编码不符(第三节)。 渗漏感再标记,有记录、病人分组、病人级别和日历时间的分出;发布、录入一致、规则完善和报告衍生的(CheXpert)标签;类型超标;调制分类器;以及更丰富的图像表述(第四节至第五节)。 多式联运不平衡基准清单(第六节)。

blocks.en: Reusable diagnostics for benchmarks on multi-record clinical cohorts, which need no retraining or only trivial baselines: a no-learning EHR lookup table, a seen/unseen-patient split of the test set, an identifier test for tabular features, a reconstruction of the labels from source codes, and a prior-diagnosis baseline.
blocks.zh: 多记录的临床组别基准的可重复使用诊断方法,这些基准不需要再培训,或仅是微不足道的基线:不学习的EHR检索表、见/不见的病人对成套测试的分拆、表格特征的识别特征测试、从源代码中重建标签以及前诊断基线。

blocks.en: A leakage and label audit of the case study: three leakage channels and an exact reconstruction of the released labels from MIMIC-IV codes showing that several target names do not match the codes behind them (Section III ).
blocks.zh: 案例研究的渗漏和标签审计:三个渗漏通道和MIMIC-IV编码中释放出标签的确切重建,表明若干目标名称与后面的编码不符(第三节)。

blocks.en: A leakage-aware re-benchmark with record, patient-grouped, patient-level and calendar-time splits; released, admission-aligned, rule-refined and report-derived (CheXpert) labels; type-aware oversampling; tuned classifiers; and richer image representations (Sections IV – V ).
blocks.zh: 渗漏感再标记,包含记录、病人分组、病人级别和日历时间的分出;发布、录入调整、规则修改和报告衍生(CheXpert)标签;类型超标;调制分类器;以及更丰富的图像表述(第四节-第五节)。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Imbalance handling. Data-level methods (random oversampling, SMOTE [ 3 ] and its variants) and algorithm-level methods (cost-sensitive learning, balanced bagging and boosting [ 10 , 11 ] ) are standard [ 4 ] . Large benchmarks show that oversampling rarely helps strong, well-tuned classifiers [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 不平衡处理。 数据级方法(随机过采样,SMOTE [3]及其变体)和算法级方法(成本敏感的学习,平衡包和助推[10,11])是标准 [4]. 大型基准显示,过量采样很少有助于强健,调适的分类者[12].

blocks.en: Leakage and label quality in clinical ML. Record-wise cross-validation can grossly overestimate subject-level performance [ 5 ] . Splitting by slice instead of by patient inflated test accuracy in brain MRI [ 13 ] , and surveys [ 7 , 6 ] list duplicated subjects across splits and features unavailable at prediction time as leading sources of over-optimism. Labels mined from codes or reports are a second weak point: the most frequent ICD codes in MIMIC-III are under-recorded by up to 35% [ 14 ] , and radiologist review of public chest-radiograph labels found positive predictive values well below the documented ones [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 临床ML中的泄漏和标签质量. 记录式的交叉验证可以严重地高估主题级别性能[5]. 以切片来划分,而不是通过病人夸大脑磁共振的测试精度[13],以及调查[7,6]列出了在预测时无法作为超乐观主义主要来源的各种被划分和特征的重复主体。 从代码或报告中取出标签是第二个薄弱点:MIMIC-III中最常见的ICD代码记录不足,高达35%[14],而放射学家对公共胸射线标志的审查发现,正预测值远低于所记录的数值[15].

blocks.en: CXR–EHR fusion. Combining radiographs with EHR data improves some diagnostic tasks [ 16 , 17 ] , and recent benchmarks stress that the benefit depends on task, cohort and fusion design [ 18 , 19 ] . Our cohort and image representation are inherited from a transfer-learning study [ 8 , 9 ] that used TorchXRayVision models [ 20 ] pretrained on CheXpert [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: CXR-EHR核聚变. 将放射图与EHR数据结合起来可以改进一些诊断任务[16,17],而最近的基准强调,好处取决于任务、组群和聚变设计[18,19]。 我们的组群和图像代表来自一项转移学习研究[8,9],该研究使用了火炬射影模型[20]在CheXpert上预先训练[21].

blocks.en: III Cohort and Leakage Audit
blocks.zh: 三. 联合审计和泄漏审计

blocks.en: III-A Cohort and representations
blocks.zh: 三. A 协作和陈述

blocks.en: The analysis file contains 29,083 radiographs (one per hospital admission) from 10,479 patients in MIMIC-IV/MIMIC-CXR. A patient contributes 2.78 radiographs on average (maximum 68), and 6,074 patients have more than one. Eight binary targets (pneumonia, tuberculosis, bronchitis, arthritis, fracture, lung cancer, scoliosis, lung infection) were derived from ICD diagnosis titles (Section III-C ). Table I shows that the effective number of positive patients is far smaller than the number of positive radiographs; scoliosis has only 45 positive patients.
blocks.zh: 分析档案载有29 083份无线电图(每所医院收治一次),来自MIMIC-IV/MIMIC-CXR的10 479名病人。 患者平均贡献2.78幅放射图(最大68幅),6,074名患者拥有多幅. 8个二进制目标(肺炎、结核病、支气管炎、关节炎、骨折、肺癌、骨质疏松、肺感染)来自国际疾病诊断标题(第三节-C节)。 页:1 我显示,有效的阳性病人数量远小于正性放射图的数量;而硬化只有45个正性病人.

blocks.en: EHR. Seven continuous variables (age, oxygen saturation, heart rate, temperature, haemoglobin, red and white blood cell counts) and four binary variables (diabetes, HIV, smoking, cough). Oxygen saturation, heart rate and temperature are missing in 93.8%, 75.9% and 76.1% of radiographs. These are general measurements rather than disease-specific predictors; we keep them because the aim is to audit the benchmark as released, and Section IV-F adds the diagnostic history.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-03-26). EHR. 7个连续变量(年龄,氧饱和,心率,温度,血红蛋白,红白血球计数)和4个二元变量(糖尿病,艾滋病毒,吸烟,咳嗽). 氧气饱和度,心率和温度的缺失率分别为93.8%,75.9%和76.1%. 这些是一般性的测量,而不是针对具体疾病的预测器;我们保留这些预测器,因为其目的是对公布的基准进行审计,第四节F部分增加了诊断历史。

blocks.en: Image. Each radiograph is represented by the 18 pre-sigmoid outputs of the TorchXRayVision DenseNet-121 trained on CheXpert ( densenet121-res224-chex ), one per pathology head [ 20 , 21 ] . Re-extracting these outputs from the MIMIC-CXR-JPG images with the library’s standard preprocessing reproduced every non-constant column of the analysis file up to a linear transformation (Pearson r = 1.000 r=1.000 for every column over all 29,083 radiographs). The other seven columns are identically zero ( | x | < 3 × 10 − 38 |x|<3\times 10^{-38} ); they are the seven heads that CheXpert labels do not cover. The image input is therefore 11 pathology scores, not a learned latent embedding. Views are mixed: 51.0% AP, 18.8% PA, 28.3% lateral and 1.9% unrecorded, and lateral radiographs are scored by the same pathology heads as frontal ones.

TABLE I: Released labels ( N N = 29,083 radiographs, 10,479 patients) and label audit. Own-neg.: released positives that are negative in the radiograph’s own admission; later: the subset whose label came from a later admission; cons.: positive patients whose source admission has a code consistent with the rule-refined (C) definition; A, C: prevalence (% of radiographs) and positive patients of the admission-aligned and rule-refined labels (Section III-C ).
blocks.zh: 表格 一:已放出标签(N = 29,083个放射图,10,479个患者)并进行标签审核. Own-neg.:在射电图本身的录入中释放出为阴性的阳性;后:其标签出自后期录入的子集; cons.:其来源录入代码符合规则(C)定义的阳性病人; A, C:收录相通和规则(III-C节)标签的阳性病人.

blocks.en: III-B Three leakage channels
blocks.zh: 页:1 三道渗出道

blocks.en: L1 – Patient-level duplication. For every one of the 6,074 multi-radiograph patients, all eight labels and all 11 EHR variables are identical across that patient’s radiographs, including radiographs from different admissions years apart. A record-level split therefore copies label–feature pairs across partitions.
blocks.zh: L1 – 患者级重复. 对于6,074名多射线病人来说,所有8个标签和所有11个EHR变量在该病人的放射图上都是相同的,包括不同收治年份的放射图。 因此,一个记录级的分拆复制了标签-跨分区的地物对。

blocks.en: L2 – The EHR vector is an identifier. The 29,083 radiographs carry only 9,821 distinct EHR vectors. Each patient has exactly one, and only 152 vectors are shared between patients. Any model that can memorise exact feature combinations (deep trees, nearest neighbours) can identify the patient and copy the label.
blocks.zh: L2 – EHR向量是一个标识符. 29,083幅放射图只载有9,821个不同的EHR向量. 每个患者都有完全相同的一个,患者之间只有152个向量共享. 任何能够记忆出精确特征组合的模型(深树,相距最近的邻居)都可以识别出患者并复制标签.

blocks.en: L3 – Admission misalignment. A patient’s condition changes between admissions: acute findings such as pneumonia or a fracture resolve, whereas chronic ones such as scoliosis persist. A label coded at one admission therefore refers to that admission, not to radiographs taken months or years apart. Labels, however, come from one admission per patient and EHR values are constant per patient (Section III-C ), so most radiographs carry another admission’s diagnoses, some recorded later. In the preceding study’s code [ 9 ] , laboratory and vital-sign values are also the first row of an unsorted per-admission query with no time window, so they may postdate the radiograph, and one radiograph is kept per admission without filtering the view (hence 28.3% lateral radiographs). Patient-separated splits remove L1 and L2; for L3 we rebuild the labels per admission and add the diagnostic history known at imaging time, whereas the released laboratory and vital-sign values remain misaligned.
blocks.zh: L3 – 招生不当. 患者的病情在收治之间发生变化:急性诊断,如肺炎或骨折,而慢性诊断,如骨质疏松。 因此,在一个入境点编码的标签是指该入境点,而不是相隔数月或数年的放射图。 然而,标签来自每个病人一个入院,而EHR值是每个病人不变的(第III-C节),因此大多数放射图都带有另一个入院诊断,有些是后来记录的. 在前一项研究的代码[9]中,实验室和生命标志值也是没有时间窗口的未分类的每个入境查询的第一行,因此它们可能给无线电报上后期,每一次入境保存一幅无线电报而不过滤视图(即28.3%的横向无线电报)。 患者分离的分解去除L1和L2;对于L3,我们重建每次录入的标签并添加成像时已知的诊断史,而所释放的实验室和生命标志值仍然错位.

blocks.en: III-C Label provenance
blocks.zh: 三-C 标签出处

blocks.en: We retrieved all 75,339 admissions of the cohort’s patients and their 1.13 million ICD codes from MIMIC-IV v2.2; every cohort admission matched on identifier, admission date and radiograph date. One rule reproduces all eight released labels exactly in 10,477 of 10,479 patients (first record instead: 6,488; union of admissions: 6,664): a target is positive if any ICD long title of a single admission contains a keyword (case-insensitive), and that admission is the patient’s last record in the analysis file (not in date order). Keywords are the target names, except that lung cancer matches “malignant neoplasm” of any site and lung infection matches any title ending in “infection”. Age matches that admission in 99.99% of patients, so the EHR values were probably copied from it too; the merge itself is not in the public code.
blocks.zh: 我们从MIMIC-IV v2.2中检索了该组患者的所有75 339个入院病例及其113万个ICD代码;每个入院病例都与身份识别、入院日期和放射日期相符。 一条规则将所有8个已放出的标签完全复制到10,479个病人中的10,477个(第1个记录:6,488个;合并收治:6,664个):如果单个收治的ICD长标题包含一个关键词(case-不敏感),则目标为阳性,而收治是病人在分析文件中的最后记录(不是按日期顺序). 关键词是目标名称,但肺癌与任何地点的“恶性肿瘤”相匹配,而肺感染则与任何标题相匹配,以“感染”结束。 年龄与99.99%的病人的住院率相符,因此EHR值很可能也从中复制出来;合并本身不在公共代码中.

blocks.en: Two problems follow (Table I ). Admission misalignment: only 36.0% of radiographs carry the labels of their own admission; 31.9% inherit them from an earlier and 32.0% from a later admission. Applying the same rule to each radiograph’s own admission changes at least one label for 10,707 radiographs (36.8%), and 13–56% of the released positives per target are negative in their own admission. Keyword semantics: matched titles include personal and family history, screening, vaccination and negated codes. Only 11.1% of tuberculosis-positive patients have a tuberculosis diagnosis rather than a tuberculin reaction or a history code; 75.6% of fracture positives have a current fracture code (the most frequent match is “age-related osteoporosis without current pathological fracture”); 14.4% of lung-cancer positives have a primary lung or bronchus malignancy; and 5.4% of lung-infection positives have a lung or respiratory infection. Pneumonia (89.5%), bronchitis, arthritis and scoliosis ( ≥ \geq 99.5%) are largely consistent with the rule-refined definitions.

blocks.en: IV Leakage-Aware Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 四. 漏损意识基准设计

blocks.en: IV-A Protocols
blocks.zh: 四-A议定书

blocks.en: Table II summarises all protocols. Except for P5, all use 5-fold cross-validation with iterative multilabel stratification [ 22 ] and an inner validation set (20% of the outer training radiographs under P1, P1-A and P1-CX and of the outer training patients otherwise) for every selection decision. P1 assigns radiographs to folds regardless of the patient, as in the initial run. P2 keeps radiograph-level rows but assigns folds and inner validation sets per patient, which rules out L1 and L2 across partitions. P3 has one row per patient, the level at which the released labels exist, and uses the P2 folds, so P2/P3 comparisons are paired. Its image features are averaged over the patient’s frontal (AP/PA) radiographs, or over all radiographs for the 1,544 patients without a frontal view, including radiographs taken after the label’s source admission; P3 is therefore a retrospective whole-record analysis, not prediction at one time point.
blocks.zh: 表二汇总了所有协议。 除P5外,在每次选择决定时,均使用带有迭代多标签分层[22]的5倍交叉验证和内置验证集(占P1、P1-A和P1-CX下外部训练射线图的20%,以及外部训练病人的20%)。 P1像最初运行时一样,分配放射图来折叠,而不论患者. P2保留了放射图级别行,但为每个患者分配折叠和内置验证套件,这排除了L1和L2横跨分区. P3每名患者有一行,即所释放的标签所存在的级别,并使用P2折叠,因此P2/P3比较被对等. 它的图像特征平均在患者的正面(AP/PA)射线图上,或者在1,544名没有前视线的患者的所有射线图上,包括标签来源录入后拍摄的射线图上;因此,P3是一种回溯性全记录分析,而不是一个时间点的预测.

Label, EHR: from the radiograph’s own admission (✓) or one value per patient (–); ∘ \circ : presumably own admission (Section III-C ), possibly measured after the radiograph. P4-H and P4-C-H replace the released EHR values by age and prior diagnoses known at imaging time.

blocks.en: IV-B Preprocessing and type-aware oversampling
blocks.zh: IV-B 预处理和型号超标取样

blocks.en: Continuous variables are standardised and imputed with a distance-weighted 5-NN imputer that appends missingness indicators. Both are fitted on the inner training set only. Binary variables pass through. We compare no augmentation , class weighting , random oversampling (ROS) , naive SMOTE on the full matrix (as in the initial run), and type-aware SMOTE-NC , which declares the four binary EHR variables and all missingness indicators categorical. Image-only inputs have no discrete columns, so they use plain SMOTE. We also include two algorithm-level ensembles: Balanced Random Forest [ 10 ] and EasyEnsemble [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 连续变量是标准化的,并用一个相距加权的5-NN分泌物进行估算,该分泌物附加了缺失指标. 两者都只安装在内部训练设施上。 二进制变量通过. 我们比较的不是扩增、类加权、随机超采样(ROS)、整个矩阵上天真的SMOTE(如初始运行时一样), 以及智取的SMOTE-NC, 只有图像输入没有离散列,所以它们使用平面SMOTE. 我们还包括两个算法层面的组合: 平衡随机森林[10]和易相集[11].

blocks.en: IV-C Richer image representations
blocks.zh: 四-C 更丰富的图像表现

blocks.en: To test whether the weak image result is a property of the 11 pathology scores, we add two embeddings extracted from the same 29,083 images: the 1024-dimensional pooled features of the same CheXpert DenseNet, and the 768-dimensional CLS embedding of RAD-DINO, a ViT-B/14 chest-radiograph encoder trained self-supervised with DINOv2 [ 23 ] (public checkpoint microsoft/rad-dino ). By image identifier, its published training list contains 28,102 (96.6%) of our radiographs and all radiographs of 10,251 of the 10,479 patients; the list contains no MIMIC-CXR image of the other 228 patients (981 radiographs), who are too few to evaluate separately, so the CheXpert-only DenseNet serves as a control without MIMIC-CXR exposure. Both use the published checkpoints, standard preprocessing, fp16 inference and float16 storage ( scripts/01_extract_embeddings.py ); the DenseNet features of the history fusions were re-extracted later with the same weights and preprocessing (Section V-F ). Each embedding is standardised and reduced to 64 principal components fitted on the inner training set; the number of components was fixed in advance, before any evaluation (Section V-F varies it). They enter as image-only and early-fusion representations under P2 and P3.
blocks.zh: 为了测试弱图像结果是否是11个病理学分数的属性,我们添加了从同名29,083个图像中提取出的两个嵌入:同名CheXpert DenseNet的1024维集合特性,以及768维CLS嵌入RAD-DINO,一个ViT-B/14胸腔辐射仪被训练出由DINOv2[23](公共检查站微软/rad-dino. 根据图像标识,其已公布的训练名单包含28,102个(96.6%)的我国无线电图和10,479个病人中10,251个的所有无线电图;该名单没有包含其他228个病人(981个无线电图)的MIMIC-CXR图像,这些病人太少,无法单独评价,因此Chexpert-lenal DenseNet在不受MIMIC-CXR曝光的情况下起到控制的作用. 两者都使用已公布的检查站,标准预处理,fp16推论和浮点16存储(脚本/01_extract_embeddings.py;历史聚变的DenseNet特征后来被以相同的权重和预处理再取出(V-F节. 每套嵌入都标准化,并减少到64个主要部件,安装在内部训练套上;在进行任何评价之前,预先确定部件的数目(第五-F节对此有所改动)。 它们在P2和P3下作为只图像和早期融合的表示输入.

blocks.en: IV-D Classifiers, selection and metrics
blocks.zh: 四-D 分类、选择和计量

blocks.en: Classifiers: logistic regression ( L 2 L_{2} , C = 1 C=1 ), Random Forest and Extra Trees [ 24 , 25 ] (300 trees, unlimited depth, minimum leaf size 1), LightGBM (300 trees, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves) and XGBoost (300 trees, depth 6, learning rate 0.05) [ 26 , 27 ] . Section V-F varies depth, leaf size and the number of trees. Other settings are library defaults (scikit-learn 1.6.1, imbalanced-learn 0.14.2, LightGBM 4.6.0); samplers balance the classes with k = min ⁡ ( 5 , n min − 1 ) k=\min(5,n_{\min}-1) neighbours; folds, samplers and models use seed 42, PCA seed 0 and the inner split of fold j j seed 4200 + j 4200+j (Section V-F varies the model seeds). Within each outer fold, preprocessing and model are fitted on the inner training set, the threshold that maximises inner-validation F2 over { 0.01 , … , 0.99 } \{0.01,\dots,0.99\} (ties: higher recall, then precision, then closeness to 0.5) is fixed, and the model is evaluated once on the outer test fold. For each protocol, target, representation and outer fold, the configuration (strategy, classifier) with the highest F2 on that fold’s inner validation set is evaluated on that fold’s test set, so under the patient-separated protocols no test patient enters any choice (under P1 and P1-A, other radiographs of a test patient can be in training and validation);

(第V-F节改变模式种子). 在每个外层折叠中,预处理和模型被安装在内层训练集上,将内层验证F2最大化于{0.01,.,.,0.99}的阈值为\{0.01,\dots,0.99\}(五十:更高的回放,再精确,再接近到0.5)被固定,模型在外层试验折叠上被一次评价. 对于每个协议、目标、表述和外折叠,该折叠的内部验证装置上F2最高的配置(战略、分类器)在该折叠的验证装置上进行评估,因此,根据病人隔离的协议,试验病人不得进入任何选择(根据P1和P1-A,试验病人的其他放射图可以用于培训和验证);

blocks.en: We report outer-test F2, PR-AUC (average precision), AUROC and, for P1–P3, the Brier score. F2 weights recall four times as heavily as precision, reflecting screening use in which a missed case costs more than a false alarm, and was the metric of the initial run (a comparison metric, not evidence of clinical utility); since the threshold is tuned for F2 and can partly absorb the effect of weighting or oversampling, we read F2 together with the threshold-free PR-AUC and AUROC. Baselines are all-positive ( F ​ 2 = 5 ​ p / ( 4 ​ p + 1 ) F2=5p/(4p+1) ) and the EHR lookup table , which copies the label of the first inner-training radiograph with the same EHR vector (fallback label chosen on inner validation; unlike in Section III-D , validation radiographs are not looked up). Fold-level results are not independent: two outer training sets share three of their four folds, so targets, classifiers and folds cannot be treated as independent samples. All intervals and tests therefore use one value per fold, the macro average over targets (and, for strategy effects, over classifiers), and the corrected resampled t t -test [ 28 ] , which replaces the factor 1 / n 1/n in the variance of the mean by 1 / n + n test / n train 1/n+n_{\mathrm{test}}/n_{\mathrm{train}} ( n = 5 n=5 folds, or 10 over two fold assignments; n test / n train = 0.2 / 0.64 n_{\mathrm{test}}/n_{\mathrm{train}}=0.2/0.64 ). Margins over all-positive are Bonferroni-corrected within each table, the eight planned F2 comparisons of the encoder control (Section V-D ) are Holm-corrected together, and strategy effects (paired against no augmentation with the same classifier) are Holm-corrected [ 29 ] over the 58 strategy × \times representation × \times protocol tests; all other p-values are unadjusted and exploratory. With five folds these tests have little power, so a non-significant difference does not establish equivalence. The grid comprises 680 tasks and 15,680 model fits, all of which completed.
blocks.zh: 我们报告外试F2,PR-AUC(平均精度),AUROC,对于P1-P3,Brier分数。 F2重量比精确率高4倍,反映了筛选用途,即漏掉的病例成本大于假警报,是初始运行的衡量标准(比较度量,而不是临床实用性的证据);由于阈值为F2调制,可以部分地吸收加权或过度采样的效果,因此我们阅读了F2以及无阈值PR-AUC和AUROC。 基线为全阳性(F 2 = 5 p / (4 p + 1) F2 = 5p/ (4p+1))和EHR检索表,该表将第一个内训射线图的标签与相同的EHR矢量相复制(在内部验证上选择倒回标签;与第三节-D部分不同的是,验证射线图没有被查取). Fold-level结果不独立:两套外出训练集共享了自己四个折叠中的三个,因此目标,分级和折叠不能作为独立样品处理. 因此,所有间隔和测试都使用每折叠一个值,宏平均值大于目标(对于战略效果,高于分级器),以及被更正的重印 t - t 测试 [28],以 1 / n + n 测试 / n 列车的平均值相差值取代 1 / n / n 1/n 1/n+n_{\mathrm{test}}/n_{\mathrm{train}}(n=5n=5折叠,或双折叠任务后10折叠;n test test /n_{\mathrm{test}}/n_{\mathrm{train}}=0.2/0.64). 在所有阳性者的比值上,在每表中均被修正了Bonferroni,编码器控制(V-D节)的8个计划中的F2比值被合并修正了,战略效果(与无增量同级)在58个策略上被修正了[29];其他所有p-值都是未经调整和探索的. 由于这些测试有5个折叠,功率很小,因此一个非显著的差别不能确定等同性. 电网由680个任务和15,680个型号相适应组成,全部完成.

blocks.en: IV-E Admission-aligned labels and a calendar-time split
blocks.zh: 四-E 校正标签和日历时间划分

blocks.en: Besides the released labels (R) we evaluate admission-aligned labels (A), obtained by applying the reconstructed rule to each radiograph’s own admission, and rule-refined labels (C), which also drop history, screening, vaccination, tuberculin-reaction, “Encounter for…” and negated titles (injury titles with “initial encounter” are kept) and restrict lung cancer to primary lung or bronchus malignancy and lung infection to lung or respiratory infection. The task is to predict the diagnoses coded for the radiograph’s admission, which need not be visible on the radiograph or present at the moment of imaging; a missing code counts as negative; all labels are rule-defined, and the rule-refined labels are not clinically verified. Laboratory and vital-sign values were not re-extracted per admission and are kept as released. Four further protocols use a reduced grid (EHR, 11 scores, RAD-DINO image and RAD-DINO fusion; no augmentation, class weighting, ROS and SMOTE/SMOTE-NC; logistic regression, LightGBM and Extra Trees): P1-A , the P1 folds with A labels (EHR and 11 scores); P4 and P4-C , the P2 patient folds with A and C labels; and P5 , a single calendar-time split with R and A labels. MIMIC shifts dates per patient, so ordering patients by recorded dates is close to random. We therefore estimate each radiograph’s real year from the patient’s anchor-year group and assign patients by their first radiograph (64/16/20% train/validation/test; about 2010–2015 vs. 2015–2018), with 95% confidence intervals from 1,000 patient-level bootstrap resamples. Later radiographs of training patients can fall in the test period (30.5% of training radiographs), so P5 tests transfer to later-enrolled patients rather than a strict temporal cut-off. As a further baseline, a prior-diagnosis rule predicts positive if the target was coded in any earlier admission of the patient, which is known at imaging time. These runs add 5,568 fits.
blocks.zh: 除了公布的标签(R)之外,我们评价通过将重建的规则应用于每个放射图本身的承认而获得的与录取一致的标签(A),以及经过完善的规则标签(C),这些标签还降低了历史、筛查、接种、管球-反应、“......碰头”和否定的头衔(保留了“初次接触”的伤害头衔),并将肺癌限制在主要的肺部或支气管恶性疾病和肺部或呼吸道感染。 任务是预测为收录放射图而编码的诊断,在成像时不需要在放射图上可见或现出;缺失的代码计为负数;所有标签都是由规则定义的,经过规则修改的标签没有临床验证. 化验室和生命标志值没有每一次重新取出,而是保持为释放。 另有4个协议使用被缩小的网格(EHR,11分,RAD-DINO图像和RAD-DINO聚变;不增强,类加权,ROS和SMOTE/SMOTE-NC;物流回归,LightGBM和外树):P1-A,P1折叠有A标签(EHR和11分);P4和P4-C,P2病人以A和C标签折叠;和P5,单日历时间分出R和A标签. 每名患者的MIMIC班次日期,因此按记录日期订购患者接近于随机. 因此,我们从患者锚地年组中估算出每幅放射图的活年,并用第一幅放射图(64/16/20%的列车/验证/测试;约2010-2015年对2015-2018年)来分配患者,其中95%的置信间隔来自1,000个患者级的靴子重印。 后期培训病人的放射图在测试期会下降(占培训无线电图的30.5%),因此P5测试转移到后期注册病人身上,而不是严格的时间断接. 作为又一基线,前期诊断规则预测目标是否在任何较早的患者入院时被编码为阳性,这在成像时即为已知. 这些赛跑增加了5,568发合身.

blocks.en: IV-F A second label source and time-aligned history
blocks.zh: 四至六岁 第二个标签来源和时间同步历史

blocks.en: To test whether the findings depend on how the released labels were built, we also use the CheXpert labels that MIMIC-CXR-JPG provides for the report of each study [ 30 , 21 ] . They are defined per radiograph rather than per patient. We take eight observations (pneumonia, lung opacity, pleural effusion, cardiomegaly, edema, pneumothorax, fracture, lung lesion; prevalence 1.4–27.9%) and count uncertain and unmentioned findings as negative (U-zeros). Among patients with several radiographs, the label varies within the patient for 31–56% of patients for the five common findings and 5–10% for the three rare ones; the released labels never vary. We compare the P1 record folds with the P2 patient folds using the reduced grid above. As an analogue of the prior-diagnosis rule, a prior-study rule predicts positive if an earlier radiograph of the patient was positive.
blocks.zh: 为了检验调查结果是否取决于所释放的标签是如何构建的,我们还使用MIMIC-CXR-JPG为每项研究提供的报告[30,21]的CheXpert标签. 它们的定义是每个放射图而不是每个病人。 我们进行了8次观察(肺炎、肺部不透明、胸膜充血、心肺、水肿、肺炎、骨折、肺部损伤;流行程度为1.4-27.9%),并将不确定和未提及的调查结果算作阴性(U-零)。 在几个放射图的患者中,有31-56%的患者在患者内部的标签有差异,有5个常见的发现,有5-10%的患者在3个罕见的患者身上的标签有差异;所释放的标签从未变化. 我们比较P1记录折叠与P2病人的折叠,使用上面被缩小的网格. 作为前期诊断规则的类比,前期研究规则预测,如果患者较早的放射图为正.

blocks.en: To test whether time-aligned EHR information helps, we build a time-aligned history vector for each radiograph: age at the radiograph’s own admission and eight flags that mark whether each target was coded in an earlier admission (A or C definition), counting only earlier admissions that ended before the radiograph’s admission began, so the flags are known at imaging time if an admission’s codes are available once it has ended (this excludes one admission that overlapped the radiograph’s admission by 15 hours and removes one pneumonia flag). It enters alone and fused with RAD-DINO on the P2 folds with A labels ( P4-H ) and C labels ( P4-C-H ). These runs add 5,760 fits. As an encoder control without MIMIC-CXR exposure, the DenseNet features enter alone and fused with the released EHR variables (P4, P4-C) and with the history (P4-H, P4-C-H), with the same folds, labels, preprocessing, grid and selection rule (2,880 fits); the history and both history fusions contain the same age variable. Table VI lists the robustness checks with their fits (34,272; 64,160 in total).
blocks.zh: 为了测试时间相通的EHR信息是否有所帮助,我们为每个射电图构建一个时间相通的历史矢量:射电图本身录入的年龄和标出每个目标是否在较早录入(A或C定义)中编码的八道旗帜,只计算在射电图录入开始前结束的更早录入,因此,如果录入的代码一经收完,在成像时就知道了这些旗帜(这不包括一次录入与射电图录入重复15小时并去掉一面肺炎旗帜). 它单独进入并在P2折叠上与RAD-DINO相接并有A标签(P4-H)和C标签(P4-C-H). 这些跑道增加了5,760发子弹。 作为没有MIMIC-CXR曝光的编码器控制器,DenseNet功能单独输入并和所释放的EHR变量(P4,P4-C)和历史(P4-H,P4-C-H)相接而成,具有相同的折叠,标签,预处理,网格和选择规则(2,880相适应);历史和两个历史聚变包含相同的年龄变量. 表六列出了符合要求的稳健性检查(34,272;共计64,160个)。

blocks.en: Table III summarises macro test performance. Under P1, the selected EHR-only models reach a macro F2 of 0.791 and an AUROC of 0.960. This is essentially the score of the no-learning lookup table (0.788), which finds an exact EHR match for 78.4% of test radiographs. Once patients are separated, the lookup hit rate falls to 7.2–7.4% (patients who happen to share an EHR vector) and its F2 to the all-positive level. EHR-only F2 falls to 0.280 under P2 ( − 0.002 -0.002 relative to all-positive) and 0.320 under P3 ( + 0.010 +0.010 ). P3 counts each patient once, which raises the all-positive level (0.310 vs. 0.282), so P2 and P3 are compared by their margins. Restricting P2 to the grid of P1 (same features, classifiers and strategies) changes its macro F2 by at most 0.002, so P1 and P2 differ only in the split. Under P2 and P3 no representation exceeds the all-positive baseline by more than 0.038 macro F2, and the best AUROC is 0.661.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 shows paired changes in test F2 relative to no augmentation with the same classifier, target and fold, separately for EHR, image and fusion inputs. Under P2 and P3 the mean changes lie between − 0.002 -0.002 and + 0.006 +0.006 , with upper 95% limits of at most 0.014; the few intervals that exclude zero (image and fusion inputs under P3) correspond to gains below 0.007. Of the 58 strategy × \times representation × \times protocol tests, two remain significant after Holm correction, both losses under P1; no gain under P2 or P3 (at most 0.009) is significant. When the best classifier is selected separately for each strategy, no augmentation comes within 0.007 macro F2 of the best strategy for every representation under P2 and P3. Balanced Random Forest and EasyEnsemble reach the same level (P3 RAD-DINO fusion: 0.344 and 0.334 vs. 0.344). Type-aware SMOTE-NC, which keeps binary and missingness columns binary (naive SMOTE gave them non-binary values in 11.2–77.4% of synthetic rows), is never better than naive SMOTE and lowers PR-AUC slightly ( − 0.001 -0.001 to − 0.016 -0.016 ). Rebalancing degrades the probabilities: relative to no augmentation it raises the Brier score by 0.02–0.08 under P2 and P3 (mean over classifiers; logistic regression alone: 0.10–0.17), and because selection optimises F2, most selected models are rebalanced and score far worse than predicting the training prevalence (Table III ), consistent with [ 31 ] .

blocks.en: Most of the record-split advantage came from the copied labels. Under P1-A, the EHR-only model falls from 0.791 to 0.421 macro F2, and its margin over the all-positive baseline from 0.509 to 0.131. The lookup table still finds an exact EHR match for 78.4% of test radiographs but now reaches only 0.355, because a patient’s other admissions no longer share the label. The remaining margin is still leakage: seen patients score 0.449 and unseen ones 0.289 (all-positive 0.336). It reflects diagnoses that persist across admissions; scoliosis, for instance, still scores 0.297 against an all-positive level of 0.022.
blocks.zh: 大部分分录的优势来自被复制的标签. 在P1-A下,仅EHR模型从0.791降至0.421宏F2,其相对于全正基线的比值从0.509降至0.131. 检查表仍然发现78.4%的测试放射图精确的EHR匹配,但现在只达到0.355,因为患者的其他收治者不再共享标签. 其余的比值仍然是渗出:所见病人得分为0.449分,未见者为0.289分(均为阳性0.336)。 它反映了在入院期间持续存在的诊断结果;例如,在0.022的全阳性水平上,骨质疏松仍为0.297分。

blocks.en: With patients separated, the image carries the signal. Under P4 the released EHR variables and the 11 pathology scores stay at the all-positive level. The weak EHR result also persists in the source-admission subset (Section V-F ), although re-timed laboratory and vital-sign values were not tested. RAD-DINO image and fusion models, by contrast, gain 0.025 and 0.027 (AUROC 0.637 and 0.650; RAD-DINO vs. EHR + 0.022 +0.022 F2 and + 0.058 +0.058 AUROC, p = 0.02 p=0.02 and p = 0.003 p=0.003 ). With rule-refined labels (P4-C) the gap widens: RAD-DINO gains 0.054 over all-positive and exceeds EHR by 0.047 F2 and 0.099 AUROC ( p = 0.008 p=0.008 and p = 0.005 p=0.005 ), and adding EHR to RAD-DINO gives no significant gain ( + 0.005 +0.005 , p = 0.60 p=0.60 ). After Holm adjustment (Table V ), the CheXpert-only DenseNet exceeds all-positive with C labels but not with A labels, and RAD-DINO’s advantage over it (0.019 and 0.032 F2) is not significant. The control supports image signal without MIMIC-CXR exposure; how much the overlap adds to RAD-DINO is undetermined, because the encoders also differ in architecture, objective and training data. Lung cancer is the clearest case: for the admission-aligned label built with the released keyword rule (any malignancy, including history codes) RAD-DINO reaches an AUROC of 0.650 under P4, and for primary lung malignancy (P4-C) 0.818 (F2 0.369 vs. 0.155 all-positive); the rule-refined label changes the target and its prevalence as well as the rule. The calendar-time split gives the same ordering (Table IV ).

blocks.en: Diagnostic history is the strongest input. Predicting positive whenever the target was coded in an earlier admission reaches 0.385 macro F2 under P4 and 0.337 under P4-C, above every model trained on the released features (best 0.318 and 0.245). The rule is strongest for chronic conditions (under P4: arthritis 0.525, lung cancer 0.741, scoliosis 0.385) and weak for pneumonia (0.272 vs. 0.690 all-positive); none of the 11 released EHR variables encodes this history. Models on the time-aligned history vector reach 0.439 (P4-H) and 0.371 (P4-C-H), + 0.145 +0.145 and + 0.177 +0.177 F2 over the released EHR variables ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; the gain comes from the prior-diagnosis flags, Section V-F ), and beat the rule by + 0.055 +0.055 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) with admission-aligned labels; with rule-refined labels the margin ( + 0.033 +0.033 , p = 0.06 p=0.06 ) is not significant. Fusing history with RAD-DINO gives the highest macro AUROC among the patient-separated A/C models in Table IV (0.766 and 0.762; + 0.025 +0.025 and + 0.049 +0.049 over history alone, unadjusted p ≤ 0.010 p\leq 0.010 ), while F2 changes little ( + 0.005 +0.005 and + 0.013 +0.013 , not significant). With re-extracted DenseNet features (Section V-F ), the history fusion shows no statistically significant improvement over history alone in F2 (Table V ) or AUROC ( + 0.009 +0.009 and + 0.016 +0.016 , p = 0.29 p=0.29 and 0.08 0.08 ), and its AUROC is 0.016 and 0.033 below that of the RAD-DINO history fusion ( p = 0.07 p=0.07 and 0.02 0.02 ). Without MIMIC-CXR exposure, these results therefore do not establish that the image adds to the time-aligned history; whether the AUROC gain with RAD-DINO reflects a stronger encoder or its pretraining overlap is undetermined.
blocks.zh: 诊断史是最强的输入. 凡在较早的一次录取中将目标编码为P4下0.385个宏F2和P4-C下0.337个宏F2时,预测为阳性,高于每个接受过释放特征培训的模型(最佳0.318和0.245)。 该规则对慢性病最强(P4下:关节炎0.525,肺癌0.741,骨质疏松0.385等),对肺炎最弱(0.272对0.690为全阳性);释放的11个EHR变量都没有编码这个历史. 时间相通历史向量的模型为:0.439(P4-H)和0.371(P4-C-H),+0.145+0.145和+0.177+0.177 F2,高于释放的EHR变量(p < 0.001 p < 0.001;收益取自前期诊断旗帜,第五节-F),将规则以+0.055 + 0.055 (p < 0.001 p < 0.001)打入-相通标签;有规则完善的标签(+0.033 + 0.033,p=0.06 p=0.06)的差值并不显著. 将历史与RAD-DINO相融合,在表四(0.766和0.762;+0.025+0.025和+0.049+0.049)中病人分离的A/C模型中给予最大的AUROC,而F2变化不大(+0.005+0.005和+0.013+0.013,并不显著). 由于重新取出DenseNet特性(第五节-F节),历史聚变在F2(表五)或AUROC(+0.009+0.009和+0.016+0.016,p=0.29 p=0.29和0.08 0.08)中没有显示统计学上相对于历史的显著改善,其AUROC比RAD-DINO历史聚变低0.016和0.033 (p=0.07 p=0.07和0.02 0.02)。 因此,如果没有MIMIC-CXR的曝光,这些结果不能证明图像会增加时间相通的历史;AUROC与RAD-DINO的增益是否反映了更强的编码器,或者其预先训练的重叠还不确定.

blocks.en: V-E A second label source
blocks.zh: 维-欧 第二个标签来源

blocks.en: We repeat the protocol comparison with CheXpert report labels of the same radiographs (all-positive F2 0.370; prior-study rule 0.253).
blocks.zh: 我们重复了与CheXpert报告同一放射图的标签(所有阳性F2 0.370;前修规则0.253)的比较。

blocks.en: With per-radiograph labels the record split barely inflates. The record split raises EHR-only F2 by only 0.021 over the patient split (0.394 vs. 0.373), and the margins of the image models over all-positive differ by at most 0.002 between the two splits. The lookup table still finds an exact EHR match for 78.4% of test radiographs, but reaches only 0.297, below the all-positive level (0.370), because a patient’s radiographs no longer share a label. This is consistent with patient overlap inflating results mainly when labels are shared across a patient’s records, as the released labels were; the CheXpert targets also differ in definition and prevalence, so the comparison does not isolate the effect of copied labels.
blocks.zh: 每幅射线画都贴满了标签 唱片的分量几乎是夸张的 记录分数在患者分数(0.394 vs. 0.373)中仅将EHR-F2提升为0.021,图像模型在全阳性上相差最多为0.002. 检查表仍然发现78.4%的测试射电图精确的EHR匹配,但只达到0.297分,低于全阳性水平(0.370分),因为患者的射电图不再具有同名标签. 这与患者重叠膨胀的结果是一致的,主要是当标签在患者的记录中共享时,就像释放的标签一样;CheXpert目标在定义和流行性上也有所不同,因此比较不会孤立被复制的标签的效果.

blocks.en: The image carries the signal. Under P2, RAD-DINO (0.438, AUROC 0.722) exceeds the released EHR variables (0.373) by 0.065 F2 and 0.142 AUROC and the 11 pathology scores by 0.034 F2 and 0.057 AUROC ( p ≤ 0.007 p\leq 0.007 ); adding EHR gives no significant gain ( + 0.002 +0.002 , p = 0.72 p=0.72 ). Imbalance strategies again improve F2 by at most 0.005 0.005 with no Holm-significant effect, SMOTE-NC lowers fusion F2 by 0.014, and logistic regression is selected in 116 of 160 fold-level choices.

blocks.en: None of the checks in Table VI changes an effect estimate materially; across model seeds, the history-versus-prior-rule comparison with C labels crosses the nominal 0.05 threshold ( p = 0.03 p=0.03 – 0.06 0.06 ). Repeated runs test determinism, model seeds give the spread of the paired differences, and the second fold assignment varies the folds. Patient separation exposes the effective sample size: positive patients per test fold are 9 for scoliosis with released labels (15–21 with A or C labels) and, with C labels, 7–17 for tuberculosis and 12–23 for lung infection, so per-target F2 for these targets is highly uncertain.
blocks.zh: 表六中的检查都没有实质性地改变效果估计;在模型种子中,历史与C标签的比对越过了名义的0.05阈值(p=0.03 p=0.03 – 0.06 0.06)。 重复运行测试定型,模型种子给出了成对差异的传播,而第二个折叠任务则会改变折叠. 患者隔离暴露出有效的样本大小:每个测试折叠的阳性患者有9个被放出标签(15–21有A或C标签)的硬化症患者,有C标签的患者有7–17个肺结核患者和12–23个被肺感染患者,因此这些目标的每个目标F2非常不确定.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: What the leakage explains. Three conclusions of the initial run change once patients are separated. (i) EHR over imaging: the EHR vector identifies the patient, so EHR-only models won by recall of identity, not by clinical signal. (ii) Tree ensembles everywhere: deep trees memorise exact feature combinations; limiting their depth removes the record-split advantage, and leaky validation still selects the deepest trees. (iii) Sampler winners: once identity drives the score, sampler differences shrink to within 0.01 F2, and no reliable sampler winner emerges under the evaluated protocols. The copied labels amplify all three effects: with admission-aligned labels three quarters of the EHR-only margin under the record split disappears.
blocks.zh: 渗出的原因 患者分离后初步运行变化的三个结论. (一)EHR 凌驾于成像之上:EHR载体识别出患者,所以EHR 唯一的模型通过召回身份而不是临床信号而取胜. (二)树群出处:深树记忆出确切的地物组合;限制其深度去除记录-分出优势,漏出验证仍然选择最深树. (三)标本优胜者:一旦身份驱动分数,标本优胜者差异缩小到0.01 F2以内,在评价协议下没有出现可靠的标本优胜者. 被复制的标签放大了所有三种效果:在记录下,只有EHR的四分之三的标签会分拆而消失.

blocks.en: Image signal and complementarity. The evidence that radiographs carry signal is stronger than the evidence that the modalities complement each other: image-only models exceed all-positive under P4 and P4-C, including the DenseNet control with C labels, but adding EHR to RAD-DINO changes P4-C F2 only from 0.240 to 0.245 ( p = 0.60 p=0.60 ), and fusion gains are clearer in AUROC than in F2 (P3 fusion vs. EHR: AUROC + 0.054 +0.054 , p = 0.04 p=0.04 ; F2 + 0.028 +0.028 , p = 0.11 p=0.11 ; likewise for history plus RAD-DINO, whereas history plus DenseNet improved neither metric significantly, Section V-D ). We read the fusion results as exploratory.
blocks.zh: 图像信号与互补. 相较于模式互补的证据,射电图携带信号的证据更强:只图像模型超过P4和P4-C下的所有阳性,包括带有C标签的DenseNet控制,但将EHR加到RAD-DINO上,只将P4-C F2从0.240修改为0.245 (p = 0.60 p = 0.60),聚变增益在AUROC中比F2(P3聚变 vs. EHR:AUROC + 0.054 + 0.054,p=0.04 p=0.04;F2 + 0.028 + 0.028,p=0.11 p=0.11;同样,历史加RAD-DINO,而历史加DenseNet的改进都不明显,V-D节。 我们把核聚变结果看成是探索性的。

blocks.en: Limitations. The study uses one cohort from one hospital system. Laboratory values and vital signs were not re-extracted per admission or restricted to measurements before the radiograph; only age and diagnostic history were time-aligned. RAD-DINO saw 96.6% of our radiographs, without labels, during pretraining [ 23 ] ; patient separation downstream does not remove this overlap, so its results may be optimistic; how much the overlap adds is undetermined, because the DenseNet control also differs in architecture, objective and training data, and no matched encoder trained without these patients was available. Image encoders were used frozen, so imaging results may underestimate fine-tuned encoders. CheXpert labels are extracted automatically from reports and are noisy, and we used only the U-zeros policy; the rule-refined definitions are our own. The calendar-time split relies on 3-year anchor-year groups and a single split. Model seeds were varied only for P4-C, history alone under P4-C-H and P5-A, not for the history fusions, whose small differences from history alone rest on one model seed; the fold assignment was varied only for logistic regression, and strategies were combined with tuned classifiers only under P4-C (LR and LightGBM; EHR and RAD-DINO fusion). Thresholds come from a fixed grid, and calibration is reported through Brier scores only.
blocks.zh: 限制。 该研究使用一个医院系统的一个组别。 实验室值和生命体征不按每次输入重新提取,也不局限于放射图之前的测量;只有年龄和诊断历史才符合时间要求。 RAD-DINO在预训期间看到了96.6%的我们的无线电图,没有标签;下游的病人隔离不会消除这种重叠,因此其结果可能是乐观的;重叠增加的多少是不确定的,因为DenseNet控制在架构,客观和培训数据上也有所不同,没有这些病人就没有任何经过培训的匹配编码器. 图像编码器被冷冻,因此成像结果可能低估了微调编码器. Chexpert的标签是自动从报告中取出,并且很吵闹,我们只使用了U-zeros政策;规则完善后的定义是我们自己的. 日历时间分拆依靠三年锚地年组和一次分拆. 模式种子只针对P4-C, 仅在P4-C-H和P5-A下的历史,而不针对历史核聚变,其与历史的微小差异仅依赖于一个模式种子;折叠任务仅针对后勤回归而有所不同,战略与调谐分级器仅在P4-C(LR和LightGBM;EHR和RAD-DINO核聚变)下结合. 阈值来自固定的网格,校正仅通过布赖尔分数报告.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: A lookup table without learning nearly reproduced the answers of a record-split imbalance benchmark whose labels were copied across each patient’s radiographs. Evaluated by patient and with labels re-derived per admission, no evaluated imbalance strategy raised the observed mean macro F2 by more than 0.01, tuned tree ensembles showed no consistent advantage over tuned logistic regression, and time-aligned diagnostic history and image embeddings (with rule-refined labels, also one without MIMIC-CXR pretraining), not the released EHR variables, carried the signal; added to the history, neither encoder significantly improved F2, and an exploratory AUROC gain was significant only with RAD-DINO, which had seen these radiographs during pretraining. These conclusions are limited to the evaluated tasks, models, tuning ranges and metrics, and the operating points do not establish screening value; the contribution is the audit and the evaluation method. Imbalance benchmarks on multi-record clinical cohorts should be judged first by their split, their labels and their baselines, and only then by their rankings.
blocks.zh: 一个无所学的检索表几乎照搬了一个记录分解的不平衡基准的答案,该基准的标签被复制到每个病人的无线电图上。 由病人评估,每一次输入都重取标签,没有经过评价的不平衡策略将观察到的平均值F2提升了0.01以上,调制的树木组合与调制的物流回归相比没有一贯的优势,时间相通的诊断历史和图像嵌入(有规则改进的标签,一个也没有MIMIC-CXR预训的标签),没有释放的EHR变量带入了信号;加上历史,没有编码器大大改进了F2,只有RAD-DINO在预训期间才看到这些放射图,因此试制的AUROC收益是重大的。 这些结论仅限于被评价的任务,模型,调整范围和衡量标准,操作点并不确定筛选价值;贡献是审计和评价方法. 多记录的临床组群的平衡基准应首先根据其分数,标签和基线来判断,然后才根据排名来判断.
